text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet and I are heading back to the academy after a day out, when…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I… Um…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Longer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A little longer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You mean you want to stay out a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I mean… you've been looking really stressed! So you could do with a longer break, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't work so hard! You need to, uh, recharge your batteries! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but… don't worry about it. It's not a big problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Besides, you're my trainer, right? If you wear yourself out…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It'll affect my performance… So…
choice_data_list: Okay, let's go get something to eat!
Thanks for looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Right! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ahem! I mean… that sounds like an excellent way to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I suppose I could see myself joining you. But it had better be a nice restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Make this worth my while, you hear? I'm a model student, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I enjoy a lovely meal with a very happy Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, obviously! Like I just said, it'd be my problem too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So, well, I was thinking… maybe you should take it easy for a little longer…
choice_data_list: How about tea in my office?
How about tea in my office?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, hmph! How's that any different from usual?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, fine. I suppose it's not a bad idea. And it'll be easy to explain away, too. Mm.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All right, it's settled! Let's go! You'd better have some good snacks ready!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We share a laid-back conversation in my office over a nice cup of tea.
